# Environment variables

<!-- GENERATED by `nsl env list --markdown` from crates/nsl-env/src/registry.rs. Do not edit by hand: `cargo test -p nsl-env` fails if this page and the registry differ. -->

Every `NSL_*` variable the toolchain reads (163 of them), from the registry in `crates/nsl-env`. `nsl env list` prints the same table; `nsl env current` shows which are set in your shell. A **behavior** variable changes the semantics or numerics of what is compiled or executed and belongs in any record of a result; **perf** changes speed or memory only; **safety** variables bypass or inject a check; **platform** names paths, devices and topology; **diagnostic** ones print, dump or count; **test** ones only matter under the test harness. "Read at" says whether the compiler process (`compile`) or the runtime inside the compiled program (`runtime`) reads it; `test` means only a `cargo test` binary does. "Accepted" quotes what the code compares against: `1 only` means any other value, including `0`, is ignored.

## behavior (30)

| Variable | Kind | Accepted | Default | Read at | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NSL_COLLECTIVES` | enum | sim or empty / sim-gpu / nccl; anything else refuses init (rc -2) | sim | runtime | Collective backend for --devices N ZeRO runs: CPU-shm simulated, GPU-staged test backend, or real NCCL (needs an nccl build). |
| `NSL_CSHA_DUMP_SAVE_STATE` | enum | exact strings; empty/other = real values; direct_* only with save_activations_for_backward | off (real row_max/row_sum saved) | compile | Debug probe: emits PTX that overwrites the saved flash-attention softmax state with lane/warp/register probes; corrupts the backward. |
| `NSL_EMBEDDING_BWD_CPU` | bool | 1 only | off (GPU scatter-add) | runtime | Force the deterministic host scatter for the embedding backward instead of the GPU atomic scatter-add (bisections, M46 audits). |
| `NSL_FASE_BATCH_SUMSQ` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | FASE two-phase clip: batches the grad-norm sum-of-squares into one f64-accumulating call; 0 restores per-param f32 reads (bits differ). |
| `NSL_FASE_FUSED_OVERRIDE` | list | comma-separated 1/true/0/false, exactly one per WGGO layer; other token or wrong length ignores the whole spec with a warning | off (plan's own per-layer fase_fused) | compile | Test knob: replaces the WGGO plan's per-layer FASE fused/full-buffer accumulation mode table (needs WGGO overrides). |
| `NSL_FA_FWD_MMA` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on (when block/head-dim shape admits) | compile | Kill switch for the tensor-core (mma.sync) flash-attention forward; 0 selects the scalar kernel, which rounds differently. |
| `NSL_FLASH_BWD_CPU` | enum | 1 forces the CPU reference; 0 opts out of --deterministic routing (warns once); anything else = flag decides | unset: --deterministic decides, else GPU | runtime | Route the FlashAttention backward to the deterministic CPU reference (1) or opt out of that routing under --deterministic (0). |
| `NSL_FLASH_GQA_BWD_CPU` | bool | 1 only | off | runtime | Route grouped-query (GQA) FlashAttention backward to the CPU reference instead of the GPU expand-KV/native kernels. |
| `NSL_FLASH_GQA_BWD_EXPAND` | bool | 1 only | off (native grouped kernel) | runtime | Force the legacy expand-KV envelope for the GQA FlashAttention GPU backward instead of the native grouped phase-2 kernel (A/B). |
| `NSL_FUSED_LCE_GEMM` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for the GEMM-chunked fused linear+CE path (large vocab / biasless heads); 0 restores v1 kernels and refuses biasless heads. |
| `NSL_GPU_CE_BACKWARD` | bool | 0 disables; anything else on | on | runtime | Set to 0 to compute the cross-entropy backward via the host bounce instead of the device-resident kernel (~1e-6 relative rounding diff). |
| `NSL_GPU_GRAD_CLIP` | bool | 0 disables; anything else on | on | runtime | Set to 0 to compute the gradient-clip global norm on the host instead of the device (f64-accumulated; differs only by reduction order). |
| `NSL_MATMUL_BF16` | bool | 1 only engages; 0 or anything else is a no-op (falls through to TF32/pedantic resolution) | off (TF32 unless NSL_MATMUL_TF32=0 or strict-matmul) | runtime | Run cuBLAS matmuls with bf16 tensor-core compute (bf16 operand storage); beats NSL_MATMUL_TF32, loses to NSL_MATMUL_PEDANTIC. |
| `NSL_MATMUL_BF16_LT` | bool | 1 only | off (cublasGemmEx DFALT) | runtime | Issue bf16-storage GEMMs through cublasLt with explicit kernel selection and a real workspace instead of cublasGemmEx (changes bits). |
| `NSL_MATMUL_BF16_LT_TUNE` | bool | 0 disables; anything else on | on (self-disables under --cuda-graphs, --deterministic, or &gt;1 GiB scratch) | runtime | Set to 0 to skip timing cublasLt candidates per GEMM shape and take the untimed heuristic[0] kernel instead. |
| `NSL_MATMUL_BF16_LT_WORKSPACE_MIB` | int | integer MiB, clamped to 4096 (unparseable → 64) | 64 | runtime | Size in MiB of the process-lifetime cublasLt GEMM workspace; larger values admit split-k/wide-tile kernels (affects kernel choice). |
| `NSL_MATMUL_BF16_MIN_RATIO` | float | any f64 (unparsable → 512) | 512 | runtime | Min arithmetic-intensity ratio mnk/(a+b elements) for a bf16-mode GEMM to cast operands to bf16; below it the GEMM stays f32/TF32. |
| `NSL_MATMUL_BF16_ROUND` | enum | sr = stochastic; anything else = RNE | rne | runtime | Rounding for the bf16 operand cast under NSL_MATMUL_BF16=1: sr = stochastic (fresh dither per launch, blocks graph capture), else RNE. |
| `NSL_MATMUL_NO_BATCH_COLLAPSE` | bool | 1 only (anything else = off) | off (collapse enabled) | runtime | Set to 1 to keep every batched matmul on the naive nsl_bmm_f32 kernel instead of collapsing to one sgemm / strided-batched cuBLAS GEMM. |
| `NSL_MATMUL_PEDANTIC` | bool | 1 only | off | runtime | Set to 1 to force cuBLAS pedantic full-FP32 math for every matmul, overriding the TF32 default and NSL_MATMUL_BF16. |
| `NSL_MATMUL_TF32` | bool | 1 = TF32 / 0 = FP32 cores; anything else ignored (falls to default) | TF32 on (pedantic under the strict-matmul build feature) | runtime | 1 enables / 0 disables TF32 tensor-core math for cuBLAS f32 matmuls; other values ignored. NSL_MATMUL_PEDANTIC/BF16=1 take precedence. |
| `NSL_MUON_BATCH_TF32` | bool | 0 = off; anything else (incl. unset) = on | on (TF32) | runtime | Set to 0 to force strict FP32 (no TF32 tensor cores) for the batched Muon Newton-Schulz GEMMs. |
| `NSL_ROLE` | enum | router / prefill / decode; anything else = router (both sites identical) | router | runtime | Disaggregated-inference worker role for this process: router (default, monolithic), prefill, or decode. |
| `NSL_SDPA_FUSED_DISABLE` | bool | 1 only | off (fused kernel enabled) | runtime | Set to 1 to disable the fused flash-attention SDPA forward kernel and always run the decomposed attention path. |
| `NSL_SDPA_TIER_B_DISABLE` | bool | 1 only | off (Tier B used when eligible) | runtime | Set to 1 to force the base segment-masked attention kernel instead of the PCA Tier-B segment-skip PTX variant. |
| `NSL_SUM_DIM_COALESCED` | bool | 0 = off; anything else = on | on | runtime | Set to 0 to disable the coalesced sum_dim kernel route (sequential accumulation, not bit-exact vs the tree-reduce kernel). |
| `NSL_SUM_DIM_SHORT_MAX` | int | integer &gt;= 0 (u64; unparsable → 1); 0 disables both fast routes | 1 | runtime | Max reduce length (elements) routed to the one-thread-per-output sum_dim kernel; 1 is bit-exact, &gt;1 reassociates, 0 disables both. |
| `NSL_SUM_SQ_BLOCKS` | int | integer &gt;= 1 (i64; else 256) | 256 | runtime | Grid-block cap per tensor for the f64-accumulated gradient sum-of-squares kernel; changes partial-sum order, 1 = single block. |
| `NSL_SUM_SQ_CPU` | bool | 1 only | off (GPU kernel) | runtime | Set to 1 to compute a GPU tensor's sum of squares with the exact f64 CPU reduction instead of the f32-accumulating kernel. |
| `NSL_WRGA_FUSED_CUDA` | bool | 1 only (read per call, not cached) | off (CPU fallback math) | runtime | Set to 1 to let WRGA fused adapter ops (LoRA/IA3/GatedLoRA) launch the synthesized CUDA kernel instead of the CPU fallback math. |

## perf (27)

| Variable | Kind | Accepted | Default | Read at | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NSL_ARENA_SLOT_LIMIT` | int | integer slot count (trimmed); unparseable → 0 = place nothing (fail-closed) | unlimited (i64::MAX) | runtime | Place only transient-arena slots with index below N; bisection aid for arena corruption. Unparseable values place nothing. |
| `NSL_ASYNC_ALLOC` | bool | 1 only | off | runtime | Allocate GPU memory via cuMemAllocAsync from the driver's default pool instead of the caching allocator; incompatible with CUDA graphs. |
| `NSL_AUTOTUNE_FALLBACK` | bool | any value (set, even empty; docs say 1) | off | compile | Skips @autotune measurement/cost-model selection and picks the median candidate of every tuning parameter (no-GPU mode). |
| `NSL_CCR_SEGMENT_FREE` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for CCR per-segment forward early-free (memory only; already skipped under --weight-stream or --layerwise-accum). |
| `NSL_CUDA_GRAPHS` | bool | 0 disables; anything else ignored | on when the program was compiled with --cuda-graphs | runtime | Kill switch for per-region CUDA graph capture/replay in programs built with --cuda-graphs; 0 keeps every region eager. |
| `NSL_FASE_FUSED_STEP` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for the single fused AdamW step kernel (bit-exact with the interpreted ~15-launch step); 0 refuses under bf16-sr. |
| `NSL_FASE_MULTI_STEP` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for the multi-tensor pointer-table fused-AdamW launch (bit-identical); 0 falls back to the per-parameter fused step. |
| `NSL_FA_BWD_MULTIWARP` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for the 4-warp flash-attention MMA backward emission (_w4 launch contract); 0 restores single-warp, bit-identical. |
| `NSL_FUSE_ELEMENTWISE_BWD` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for fusing single-reader elementwise chains of the backward tape into one kernel (bit-exact by construction). |
| `NSL_FUSE_NORM_RESIDUAL` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for folding the residual Add into the fused RMSNorm dx backward kernel (bit-exact; needs --fuse-rmsnorm-backward). |
| `NSL_FUSE_ROPE_NEG` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for the fused rotate_half_neg backward op; 0 emits the rotate_half + Neg pair (rounding-free, bit-exact either way). |
| `NSL_FUSE_SCALAR_IMM` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on | on | compile | Kill switch for rewriting x OP const backward ops into scalar-immediate launches (bit-exact; skips the host scalar alloc/HtoD). |
| `NSL_GATHER_DIM_GPU` | bool | 0 disables; anything else on | on | runtime | Set to 0 to route non-dim-0 f32 gather back through the host copy path instead of the device gather-dim kernel (A/B). |
| `NSL_GPU_MEM_LIMIT` | int | bytes with optional K/M/G suffix (case-insensitive), e.g. 24G; 0, empty or unparseable = unlimited | 0 (unlimited) | runtime | Cap in bytes (K/M/G suffix allowed) on what the GPU caching allocator may reserve from the driver; growth past it fails as OOM. |
| `NSL_LEGACY_NULL_STREAM` | bool | 1 only (both sites) | off (per-thread compute stream) | runtime | Kill switch: launch kernels on the legacy NULL stream instead of the per-thread compute stream; also disables CUDA graph capture. |
| `NSL_MATMUL_BF16_CAST_CACHE` | bool | 0 disables; anything else on | on (active only under NSL_MATMUL_BF16=1 with RNE rounding and no --cuda-graphs) | runtime | Set to 0 to disable the persistent bf16 weight-image cache and re-cast every GEMM operand from fresh scratch. |
| `NSL_MATMUL_TRANSPOSE_VIEWS` | bool | 1 = OP_T / 0 = materialise; anything else = math-mode default | auto: on under TF32/BF16 math mode, off under FP32-cores/pedantic | runtime | 1/0 forces whether a 2-D transposed operand goes to cuBLAS as OP_T instead of being materialised; default on under TF32/BF16, else off. |
| `NSL_MUON_BATCH_MB` | int | integer MiB &gt;= 16 (below 16 or unparsable → 256) | 256 | runtime | Device workspace budget in MiB (min 16) for the batched Muon Newton-Schulz path; sets how many matrices share one launch. |
| `NSL_NO_ESCAPE_ANALYSIS` | bool | 1 only (exact match) | off (analysis runs) | compile | Disables parameter escape analysis so every call argument is assumed to escape; fresh temporaries passed to calls strand (more memory). |
| `NSL_OFFLOAD_PAGEABLE` | bool | 1 only | off (pinned) | runtime | Set to 1 to hold offloaded optimizer state in pageable heap memory instead of pinned (cuMemAllocHost) host buffers. |
| `NSL_OFFLOAD_SYNC` | bool | 1 only | off (async) | runtime | Set to 1 to force the optimizer-state offload copy-back onto the synchronous path (disables the async DtoH overlap). |
| `NSL_SKIP_GPU_DRAIN` | bool | 1 only | off (drain each step) | runtime | Set to 1 to skip the per-step release of idle caching-allocator GPU memory back to the driver. |
| `NSL_SOURCE_AD_ITEM_FOLD` | bool | 0 disables; anything else or unset = on (cached at first read per process) | on | compile | Kill switch for folding config-tensor .item() reads into tape constants; 0 restores the synchronous device readback (value-identical). |
| `NSL_STRIDED_COPY_RUN` | bool | 0 = off; anything else = on | on | runtime | Set to 0 to route every strided-view materialisation through the generic copy kernel instead of the run-planned fast path. |
| `NSL_WS_RESIDENT` | bool | 0 = off; anything else = on | on | runtime | Set to 0 to disable the capacity-aware residency policy and stream every registered weight unconditionally. |
| `NSL_WS_RESIDENT_RESERVE_MIB` | int | integer MiB (trimmed usize) | 50% of total VRAM | runtime | VRAM reserve in MiB the weight-stream residency policy keeps free for activations; weights stream until the reserve is covered. |
| `NSL_ZERO_BUCKET_MB` | float | MB as f64, fractional ok, negatives clamp to 0; 0 = per-tensor | 25 | runtime | Bucket cap in MB (fractional accepted) for flattened ZeRO collectives; 0 disables bucketing (one collective per tensor). |

| Variable | Kind | Accepted | Default | Read at | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NSL_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_DECORATORS` | bool | 1 only (exact match; set by --allow-unknown-decorators) | off | compile | Demotes the unknown-decorator-name error to a warning; documented-but-unimplemented decorators still refuse. |
| `NSL_ALLOW_UNRESOLVED_LIVE_ADJOINT` | bool | 1 only (exact match) | off (hard error) | compile | Migration escape hatch: turns the source-AD live-adjoint-with-missing-inputs hard error into a loud warning and skips the op. |
| `NSL_CPDT_FORCE_STALE_PLAN` | bool | 1 only (exact match) | off | compile | Test knob: forces the stale-CPDT-precision-plan refusal so the moment-dtype staleness gate is testable; the build fails. |
| `NSL_CSHA_MULTITILE_DW_VALIDATION` | bool | any value except 0 or empty (var_os) | off (refuse) | runtime | Let the CSHA multi-tile fused backward launch for batch&gt;1 or heads&gt;1 instead of refusing; gradients are NOT guaranteed correct. |
| `NSL_FLASH_ALLOW_FAILED` | bool | 1 only (both sites) | off (abort) | runtime | Continue with an unwritten (all-zero) attention output after a failed FlashAttention forward launch or f16 widen instead of aborting. |
| `NSL_FORCE_DEPENDENCY_ORDER_VIOLATION` | bool | 1 only (exact match) | off | compile | Test knob: forces the pass-manager dependency-order refusal (build fails naming the knob) so the enforcement arm is gate-testable. |
| `NSL_FUSED_LCE_HINT_PIN` | bool | 0 disables the abort; anything else keeps it | on (abort on hint mismatch) | runtime | Set to 0 to keep running (after printing the diagnostic) when @fused_lm_ce shape hints disagree with the real tensors, instead of aborting. |
| `NSL_FUSED_LCE_REFUSE_NON_F32` | bool | any value (presence via var_os().is_none() check, so even 0 refuses); second site is a test EnvGuard | off | runtime | Reinstate the v6 refusal: fused linear-CE FFIs return -1 for non-f32 (f16/bf16) operands instead of running the kernel. |
| `NSL_NCCL_TIMEOUT_SECS` | int | integer seconds (u64; unparsable → 300) | 300 | runtime | Seconds to wait for an NCCL collective to complete before aborting every surviving rank (dead-peer watchdog). |
| `NSL_RESUME_ALLOW_TRAJECTORY_DRIFT` | bool | 1 only | off (abort on trajectory drift) | runtime | Set to 1 to let checkpoint_load resume under changed lr/schedule/clip values with an acknowledgment instead of aborting. |
| `NSL_TAPE_ALLOW_DISCONNECTED` | bool | 1 only | off (abort) | runtime | Set to 1 to let a strict tape backward proceed when no parameter received a gradient instead of aborting as disconnected. |
| `NSL_TP_BARRIER_TIMEOUT_SECS` | int | integer seconds (u64; unparsable → 300) | 300 | runtime | Seconds a rank spins in the shared-memory collective barrier before aborting on a presumed dead peer. |
| `NSL_WGGO_FORCE_STALE_TABLE` | bool | 1 only (exact match) | off | compile | Test knob: simulates a rejected WGGO pre-plan whose replan diverges on FASE modes, forcing the stale-mode-table refusal. |

| Variable | Kind | Accepted | Default | Read at | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NSL_CUDA_DEVICE` | int | integer device ordinal (negative clamps to 0; unparseable ignored) | rank % device_count under the --devices spawner, else 0 | runtime | CUDA device ordinal this process binds; overrides the rank-striped choice made under the --devices spawner. |

| `NSL_GPU_COUNT` | int | integer GPU count (&gt;=2 = CUDA IPC available; unparseable ignored) | assume IPC available | runtime | GPU count hint for the disaggregated KV-transfer NVLink/CUDA-IPC probe; fewer than 2 disables the NVLink backend. |
| `NSL_KV_BACKEND` | enum | shared_mem / nvlink / rdma / tcp; anything else = shared_mem | auto-detect (RDMA/TCP multi-node, NVLink multi-GPU, else shared_mem) | runtime | Transport for disaggregated-inference KV-cache transfer, overriding hardware auto-detection. |
| `NSL_LOCAL_RANK` | int | any value, presence only (CLI spawner guard) / integer rank 0..world_size-1, unparsable -&gt; 0, out of range refused by ZeRO init (runtime) | unset: CLI spawns N ranks; runtime assumes rank 0 | both | This process's distributed rank; the SPMD spawner sets it per child (its presence stops re-spawning) and the runtime reads it. |
| `NSL_NCCL_LIB_DIR` | path | directory path (not validated) | unset: plain -lnccl from the system search path | compile | Directory of a non-system libnccl added as -L and -Wl,-rpath at the final link (only when the compiler has the nccl feature). |
| `NSL_RDMA_DEVICE` | string | any non-empty = RDMA available; empty = unavailable | auto-probe /sys/class/infiniband (Linux), else unavailable | runtime | RDMA NIC name for the disaggregated KV-transfer probe: non-empty forces RDMA available, empty forces unavailable, unset auto-probes. |
| `NSL_REMOTE_HOSTS` | bool | present (any value) | single-node (unless SLURM_NNODES &gt; 1) | runtime | When set (any value), marks the disaggregated KV-transfer auto-selection as multi-node, preferring RDMA then TCP over NVLink/shm. |
| `NSL_RUNTIME_LIB_PATH_OVERRIDE` | path | existing path to the nsl runtime static library; a missing path is silently ignored | toolchain &lt;exe&gt;/../lib, then the cargo build path | compile | Overrides where the linker finds the nsl runtime static library for the final link. |
| `NSL_SIMULATED_TP` | bool | 1 = simulated; anything else = not simulated (refused when world_size &gt; 1); both sites identical | 1 (simulated) | runtime | 1 (default) selects the CPU shared-memory simulated collective backend; any other value with world size &gt; 1 is refused. |
| `NSL_STDLIB_PATH` | path | existing directory; a non-directory is silently ignored | &lt;exe dir&gt;/stdlib, &lt;exe&gt;/../lib/stdlib, then ./stdlib | compile | Highest-priority root directory searched for stdlib .nsl modules (imports and train-block optimizer modules). |
| `NSL_TP_SHM_PATH` | path | path; presence alone enables rank-striped device binding, opened as shm when world_size &gt; 1 | unset: device 0, single rank; refused (-3) by zero_init if world_size &gt; 1 | runtime | Path of the spawner's shared-memory file for multi-rank collectives; required when world size &gt; 1, also enables rank-striped GPU binding. |
| `NSL_WEIGHTS_PATH` | path | path | unset (search next to binary / executable only) | runtime | Explicit path to the .nslweights sidecar, tried after the compiled-binary and executable directories. |
| `NSL_WORLD_SIZE` | int | integer (i32; unparsable → 1) | 1 | runtime | Total number of tensor-parallel ranks for nsl_tp_init; values &gt; 1 require NSL_TP_SHM_PATH. |

| `NSL_BF16_PROBE` | bool | 1 only | unset | test | Test harness only: marks the re-exec'd timing child of the bf16 matmul mode gate, which prints one PROBE line for the parent. |
| `NSL_CUDA_GRAPH_TEST_DIVERGE_FIRST` | bool | 1 only | off | runtime | Test hook: force each graph region's first replay verification to report a mismatch at op 0, exercising the eager-repair path. |
